environment.description: Kubernetes pod running in namespace 'directory-svc' on EKS cluster. Pod has service account with no special restrictions. Cluster uses default Kubernetes NetworkPolicy (none applied). The service is exposed via ClusterIP service on port 8080, reachable from any pod in the cluster. HMAC_SECRET is set via a Kubernetes Secret mounted as env var. Other services in the cluster authenticate with valid X-Service-Token headers. The ALB ingress controller exposes /health externally but the /api/v1/* paths are also routable from within the cluster mesh without additional filtering.

config.ingress: ALB ingress controller, path-based routing, no managed rule groups
